mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hyn_sys_online_session ( session_id, authorization_id, user_id, principal_name, client_id, grant_type, ip_address, location, user_agent, browser, browser_version, os_name, login_time, last_active_time, access_token_expires_at, refresh_token_expires_at, status ) VALUES ( #{sessionId}, #{authorizationId}, #{userId}, #{principalName}, #{clientId}, #{grantType}, #{ipAddress}, #{location}, #{userAgent}, #{browser}, #{browserVersion}, #{osName}, #{loginTime}, #{lastActiveTime}, #{accessTokenExpiresAt}, #{refreshTokenExpiresAt}, #{status} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM hyn_sys_online_session WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY last_active_time DESC
